title: Peanut Horchata Sorbet
changes_from_base: A soaked rice, almond and cinnamon milk blended with peanut butter and brown sugar replaces the mango, lime and syrup.
summary: A dairy-free sorbet made from homemade rice and almond milk flavoured with cinnamon, blended with peanut butter and dark brown sugar.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Grind and soak
steps.text: Grind the rice, almonds and cinnamon in the blender to a coarse powder. Tip into the bowl, stir in 600 ml of the water, cover and refrigerate for 8-12 h.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the soaked mixture and its water until white and creamy, about 2 min.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pour through the lined sieve, then gather the cloth and squeeze out as much milk as you can. Stir in the remaining 350 ml water.

steps.title: Sorbet base
steps.text: Rinse the blender and blend 500 ml of the rice-almond milk with the peanut butter, brown sugar and salt until smooth. Keep the rest of the milk in the fridge to drink.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn the cold base for 20-25 min, then freeze for at least 2 h. Leave out for 10 min before scooping.

tips: Start the soaking the night before.
Use a smooth peanut butter made only from peanuts and salt.
Drink the leftover rice-almond milk chilled, sweetened with a little brown sugar.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
